text:
Naomi Chen: quick thread — profiling run on h100l cluster (dedicated) shows regression when kernel selector picks INT4 path for seq lengths ~512-1024. throughput down ~18% vs INT8 and tails spike.

Alex R: can you paste the profile? what tool/run?

Naomi Chen: ran pickbench/trace on node gpu-12, attached output below. pick decision went to `quant_int4_best_cut` even though nvprof shows more kernel memory traffic. Also saw KV cache warmup stalls on first 3 tokens.

Priya S: interesting — our batcher heuristic has a seqlen threshold at 480 that flips to 'longseq' branch. maybe off-by-one. that could cause a cold path with suboptimal kernel.

Mark T: quick test: try force `kernel_hint: int4-lite` vs `int4-compact` — different shared-mem tiling. Also try setting `batching.max_batch_ms=6` to let batching coalesce more.

Naomi Chen: paste of relevant bits:
```
# pickbench summary
model: redwood-7b-q
hw: h100l
seq: 512..1024 (p95 740)
picked_kernel: quant_int4_best_cut
throughput_tokens/s: 1360 (int4) vs 1650 (int8)
kv_cache_misses: 0.12 -> spike at init

# nvprof hot lines
gemm_kernel_int4_sm90  48% time, 3.2GB/s
gemm_kernel_int8_sm90  35% time, 2.6GB/s

# config snippet
kernel_selector:
  seqlen_buckets: [0, 256, 480, 1024, 4096]
  per_arch_overrides:
    h100l:
      seq_penalty: 1.15
      prefer_int8_above: 768
```

Priya S: so for h100l our `prefer_int8_above` is 768 which means at p95 740 we stay int4, but due to tiling it's slower. lowering `seq_penalty` or prefer_int8_above to 640 might fix.

Alex R: i ran a quick patch: set prefer_int8_above=640 on a canary and throughput p95 went to 1620, tail latency improved. no regressions on short seqs.

Naomi Chen: good. can we add an autotune job to sweep prefer_int8_above and seq_penalty across h100l and sm90? also add KV cache warmup trace in that job.

Mark T: adding to perf-sweeps. I'll create a sweep with grid: prefer_int8_above=[512,640,768], seq_penalty=[1.0,1.15,1.3], batch_ms=[4,6,8]. include kv warmup flag.

infra-bot: deploy canary to dedicated/h100l-spot-2 queued by Mark T. link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/2209876543

Naomi Chen: thanks — next steps: (1) perf sweep, (2) short canary with prefer_int8_above=640, (3) follow-up if KV warmup persists. @Alex R can you own canary run?

Alex R: on it :+1:

Priya S: note: add telemetry tag `kernel_pick_reason` to logs so we can retroactively analyze picks across models.

Naomi Chen: agreed, will add as follow-up.
